#!/bin/bash
set +e
echo '=== ts ==='; date -u +%FT%TZ

echo '=== files on disk ==='
sudo ls -la /home/afrah/afrah-bot.py /home/afrah/afrah-responder.py 2>/dev/null

echo ''
echo '=== bot.py: attachment handling (download, mime, save-to-disk) ==='
sudo grep -nE 'attachment|contentUrl|downloadUrl|hostedContents|mime|contentType|pdf|application/|/media/|save|write_bytes|open\(.*wb' /home/afrah/afrah-bot.py 2>/dev/null | head -60

echo ''
echo '=== bot.py: how activities.jsonl entries are written ==='
sudo grep -nE 'activities.jsonl|json.dumps|activity|jsonl' /home/afrah/afrah-bot.py 2>/dev/null | head -20

echo ''
echo '=== responder.py: attachment / file / pdf mentions ==='
sudo grep -nE 'attachment|contentUrl|downloadUrl|hostedContents|mime|contentType|pdf|application/|/media/|file_path|attach' /home/afrah/afrah-responder.py 2>/dev/null | head -60

echo ''
echo '=== responder.py: how claude is invoked (args passed) ==='
sudo grep -nE 'subprocess|Popen|run_codex|claude|cmd\s*=|args\s*=' /home/afrah/afrah-responder.py 2>/dev/null | head -40

echo ''
echo '=== responder.py: prompt construction (what text/paths get sent) ==='
sudo grep -nE 'prompt|user_text|content|message|input' /home/afrah/afrah-responder.py 2>/dev/null | head -30

echo ''
echo '=== last inbound activity: does Teams even send PDF attachments to bot.py? ==='
sudo tail -5 /home/afrah/.afrah-bot/activities.jsonl 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json
for line in sys.stdin:
  try:
    a=json.loads(line); b=json.loads(a.get("body","{}"))
    atts=b.get("attachments") or []
    print(f"  time={a.get(\"ts\",\"?\")} attachments={len(atts)} types={[x.get(\"contentType\") for x in atts]}")
  except Exception as e: print(f"  parse-err: {e}")'

echo ''
echo '=== compare shape: does another per-user bot (e.g. lia) do something different? ==='
sudo diff /home/afrah/afrah-responder.py /home/lia/lia-responder.py 2>&1 | head -40

echo '===END==='
